question: By what percentage of the bare-Al value did the carbon layer reduce the sodium nucleation overpotential?
rendered:
The nucleation overpotential for bare Al was 19 mV and for carbon/Al it was 12 mV. 

To find the percentage decrease: 
(19 - 12) / 19 = 0.3684
Multiply by 100 to convert to percentage: 
0.3684 * 100 = 36.84%

The carbon layer reduced the sodium nucleation overpotential by approximately 36.84% compared to the bare-Al value.
